chapter: Scrapbook: Blue Room acts and the United Fruit ship
title: Convention jobs, Elliot Roosevelt and Blue Room singers
summary: Corporate jobs for a circuit breaker company, Elliot Roosevelt, dating a job to after Riddick left Sharkey, and singer Doris Drew.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: This was ITE, Circuit Breaker Corporation. I played many, many jobs for them all over the country. I went to the Diplomat Hotel for them. Jean Laflotte, he was from Paris, France. He writes this in French. He couldn't speak English, but talking about a cyclist. This was at the Blue Room, February the 5th, 1950.
This says from 5.30 PM, Tuesday, March 10th, but it doesn't give a year. Yeah. Well, we can figure it out pretty much. Would this be 50s or?

Yeah. This job here that you have here, do you have any idea what year that would be about? 50s, 60s?
Around this time. Around 40. Or right after I left Sharky.
I left Sharky in 1950, you understand? Yeah, yeah. Bobby Blank. I remember him.
Sam. Oh, there's a fine team right there.
